notes: WHAT THIS ROUND IS. His twelve rulings on the SPOT GRADE PAGE, taken one at a time against a generated page, in the order he gave them. Nothing in the rating pipeline moved: data/team_rating.py, src/engine/offense.ts, data/build_ratings.py and data/compute_ovr.py are byte-identical to origin/main, no card rating changed, `npm run anchors` reads 213 anchors / 0 failing, and every team:off and team:def dial in this file is the number origin/main gives. What moved is which STYLE each five reads, and those moves are listed below.

1. THE RESET — 'remove all the - across the board', carried from recal_219's iso to every spot fit in the file. Every negative term is gone: five-out's -25 a shy big (`shyBig` deleted), the triangle's TRI_SEP separation charge, motion's `ballStop`, helio's HELIO_PV_W charge, iso's ISO_PV_W (already gone in 219), the pin-down's `pinOffBall` decay and `pinCatch`'s `- x.rim`, the pin-down's `pinWing` height decay, the hand-off hub's `selfless` decay, the handler nomination's PNR_HDISC discount and PNR_PVFLOOR ramp, and recal_216's HAND_TILT. The constants are LEFT IN THE FILE as the record of what each round priced; no formula reads them.

1a. THE SIZE GATES ARE CLAMPED, NOT DELETED. `bigMan` and `elbowBig` had their height leg left UNCLAMPED BELOW the floor by recal_217/218, and that negative leg was the guard filter. It is clamped at zero here, and the RIM RAMP is what keeps guards out. recal_220 took the harder reading and deleted the size gates outright: it collapsed the board to 1,252 of the 1,255 wheel fives reading `dho`. recal_220 IS SUPERSEDED AND ABANDONED and must not be merged; its measurement stands as the record of why the harder reading was wrong, and its own receipt file is not touched by this round.

1b. WHAT THE CLAMP COSTS, MEASURED AND NOT CLAIMED AWAY. Exactly 2 of the 3,519 cards under 6'6" now reach a nonzero size term: Derrick White '26 (76", rimprot 74) and Alex Caruso '24 (77", 76), two of the best perimeter shot-blockers in the file, both just over the p75 line DHO_RIM_LO/HORN_RIM_LO 73. They read 4.8/8.9 at an elbow and 5.1/13.3 as a hub, against a Draymond of 21.8/56.0. Over the 1,255 wheel fives NEITHER is ever nominated at an elbow, and ONE is nominated as a hub (White '26 is the Celtics '26 hub, at 5.1, which is a floor value). Pinned in tests/tactics.test.ts so it cannot grow unnoticed.

2. HIS RULING: 'roll gains 3pt, pop gains rim'. rollHandler = handlerFit + 0.20 x 3pt + height; popHandler = handlerFit + 0.20 x rim + height. Measured over 500 cards: 3pt > rim reads higher on the ROLL and rim > 3pt reads higher on the POP, exactly, for every card — the difference is 0.20 x (3pt - rim). recal_216's ruling ('Pnr handler should be a better shooter than a pnp handler') is therefore satisfied as a general law rather than on a band. THE COST: recal_216 pinned Durant '16 to the ROLL off `closeout`, which read his three against a fixed 40..60 window; his card is rim 86 against a three of 80, so on the ruling's own comparison he is the POP handler. Reported, not tuned.

3. HIS RULING on height: handler flat at 6'3" (75) and under — taller is worse; roller flat at 6'10" (82) and over; popper flat at 6'8" (80) and over — shorter is worse. Each ramp spans ten inches and is worth its own weight x 99, so an inch is about a point, the same size as the 0.1-per-point terms on the three and the rim.

4. HIS RULING: 'In every spot, the value should get to 100. So if I dont achieve that, auto add the stats to 100.' `toHundred` divides each term by its OWN MEASURED ceiling (the term evaluated on an all-99 card, swept across every height, best taken) and multiplies to 100. ALL ELEVEN WRAPPED TERMS READ 100.000000, and every K is 100/99 because every raw term was built to top out at exactly 99. THE INVARIANT IS VERIFIED AND ASSERTED: each of the eleven fit use-sites divides the same `.K` straight back out, so the rescale moved no read — measured on 400 cards x 11 terms to 1e-9, and every team dial in this receipt is unmoved.
4a. ELEVEN OF THE TWELVE SPOTS READ 100. The twelfth, the CORNER/WING, reads 99.0 — that spot IS the 3pt bar and bars cap at 99. He has left it there and it is recorded here rather than tuned away.

5. HIS RULING: the post hub is 0.6 x volume + 0.4 x max((mid+rim)/2, rim), TIMES a tallness ramp flat at 6'9" (81). The ramp MULTIPLIES rather than taking a slice of the weight, so the 6:4 he named stays exactly 6:4 at every height — asserted on four cards at four heights each. recal_115's `interior()` scaling goes with the rest of the minuses, which is why a shooting big (Porzingis '25, Durant '23) prices as a post man again.
6/7. HIS RULINGS on the handler: `ballsec` at 0.1 taken out of the play-volume weight, then height up and shot down — playvol .5 / shot .2 / ballsec .1 / height .2. Four weights, sum 1.00.

8. HIS RULING: the helio engine is 0.5 x volume + 0.5 x playvol, nothing else. recal_206's CONTENT survives inside the shape — half the term is play volume, so a man who does not run the offence cannot reach the top of it, and the Spurs '16 still read helio 54.2 against a free default of 60, which is that ruling. HELIO_PV 65 and HELIO_PV_W 0.45 are kept as measurements and are read by nothing.

9. HIS RULING: popper height .40 / 3pt .45 / mid .10 / efficiency .05. 10. HIS RULING: roller height .45 / rim .45 / efficiency .10. The two screener spots now read DISJOINT shooting columns — the roller has no 3pt leg and the popper has no rim leg — so recal_214's `closeout` lerp is superseded and the mid-range sits in exactly one of the two.

11. HIS RULING: the flat elite-passer bonus is GONE from `handlerFit`. It was ELITE_LIFT +24 over a ramp from ELITE_PV 80, and because it was a FLAT ADD it never appeared as a per-point weight — which is HOW HE CAUGHT that the horns handler summed to 0.72 and not 1.00. 12. HIS RULING: `hornsHandler` is `playvol` alone at full weight.

THE INVARIANT HE SET, VERIFIED: every spot's weights sum to 1.00 and every term reads 100 on an all-99 card. Handler .5+.2+.1+.2; roller .45+.45+.10; popper .40+.45+.10+.05; post hub .6+.4; helio .5+.5; iso .40+.30+.20+.10; elbow .75+.25; hub .62+.38; pin-down .75+.25; horns handler 1.00. All asserted in tests/tactics.test.ts.

AFTER: pnr 481 · postup 231 · pindown 132 · balanced 107 · dho 105 · helio 75 · pickpop 45 · triangle 22 · iso 22 · horns 15 · motion 15 · fiveout 5. THE HARNESS, REPORTED AND NOT TUNED. `npm run harness`: PLAYSTYLE blind deviation reads -0.26 against the deviation tax law's required -0.30 or lower, and the row FAILS. Every other row passes (main scorer -0.52, main playmaker -0.80, tempo -0.80, scheme -0.56, hunt -0.38, crash off -0.51, crash def -0.42, assignment -0.45; oracle rose on playstyle, +2.20 -> +2.51).
